Subject: Post-discovery: propose eval kickoff slots & align success criteria

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the great conversation this morning. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can lock a time for an evaluation kickoff (technical deep dive + trial plan):

What I heard (summary)
- Primary goal: reduce clinical documentation latency by surfacing draft notes for clinicians (target: 30–45% reduction).
- Key success criteria: time-to-first-draft, accuracy on entity extraction (rx/meds/diagnoses), and throughput for concurrent users during peak hours.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 + VPC peering required; Jamal will lead security intake.

Immediate asks
1) Can you confirm the three people who should join the kickoff (owners + security + engineering)?
2) If you have 2–3 representative prompts or example patient note snippets we should evaluate, please attach them or paste below.

Proposed kickoff slots (PST)
- Wed Dec 2 — 10:00–11:00 AM PST
- Thu Dec 3 — 3:00–4:00 PM PST
- Mon Dec 6 — 9:00–10:00 AM PST

If none of those work, feel free to pick a slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood/eval-kickoff

I attached a short discovery notes PDF and a first draft of a proposed trial plan that lays out scope, success metrics, and a tentative prompt set. If you prefer, I can push a Mutual Action Plan (MAA) link with responsibilities; I’ve also added a checklist for trial readiness.

Attachments: discovery-notes-20261124.pdf, proposed-trial-plan-v1.docx, redwood-trial-checklist.xlsx

Next steps if we lock a time:
- We’ll bring a Solutions Engineer (Kimberly) for a tech deep dive and to confirm infrastructure needs.
- We’ll surface a short prompt pack (3–5 prompts) to run in the trial and a proposed eval rubric so we can baseline quality.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
